content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction exists anywhere in the document, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms the Customer is unrestricted.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Customer: searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "employ" and "hire" return no restrictive covenant, and neither General (§ 30) nor Confidentiality (§ 16) imposes one. To the contrary, § 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) and in fact benefits our party, so no redline is warranted. Note only that § 12.4 restrains Vendor from competing with Customer's analytics products — a restraint on the counterparty, not on us, and outside this rule.
